# Lab 16.6: Use Agents in Data Studio & the Conversational Analytics API

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the published agent from Data Studio (formerly Looker Studio), then call it from Python with the Conversational Analytics API.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Data Studio.** Open **Data Studio**, create a new report, and choose **Conversational analytics / Agents**. Select `thelook_sales_agent` and ask a question. The answer can be added to a report.

2. **[CLI] Install the client.**

3. **[CLI] Ask the agent from Python.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; ask_agent.py &lt;&lt;'EOF'
import os
from google.cloud import geminidataanalytics as gda

project = os.environ["PROJECT_ID"]
client = gda.DataChatServiceClient()
agent = f"projects/{project}/locations/global/dataAgents/thelook_sales_agent"

request = gda.ChatRequest(
    parent=f"projects/{project}/locations/global",
    messages=[gda.Message(user_message=gda.UserMessage(text="What was revenue last month?"))],
    data_agent_context=gda.DataAgentContext(data_agent=agent),
)
for chunk in client.chat(request=request):
    print(chunk)
EOF
python3 ask_agent.py</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The response streams in parts: the plan, the SQL, the data and the final text. Copy your agent ID from the agent's **Details**. The client library is new, so if a class or field name differs, compare with the **Conversational Analytics API Python quickstart**.

4. **[Console] Check the API calls.** In **APIs & Services → Gemini Data Analytics API → Metrics**, see the requests from your script.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Data Studio | Business users chat with the same agent |
| API | Agents inside your own apps |
| Response | Streamed reasoning, SQL, data and text |
| One agent | Many front ends |
